scope: One logical project with sixteen concurrent original append owners and a shared ordinary hook frontend
runtime: One native binary per fixed series; no production-source changes between protocol preflight and its load trials
sequence: Create an empty sixteen-owner project and exercise seed Prompt/Pre/Post/Stop through Daemon.hookRequest, ordinary dispatch and background publication
Verify both seed original responses and prepared source roots, then freeze head and tail in each original (four fields) before observing load delivery
Concurrent fresh writer chats each request seed evidence, then emit ordinary Pre/Post with one exact-sized deterministic varied JSON response, then Stop
Record each complete output before its ordinary receipt ACK; retain partial outcomes and stop on the first failing phase
Wait for original publication and background preparation without calling administrative warm; verify every saved tool input/output and current prepared heads
Freeze two fields of the last saved observation, then issue queries from new reader chats and record their actual initial delivery
Retire all controlled services and confirm no owned survivors
required: Every native hook completes within its original deadline; no incomplete notification counted as delivery
All four frozen seed fields are in every writer's initial body; both frozen saved-observation fields are in every fresh-reader initial body
All writer Post input/output pairs are present as original observations, not just private receipts
Current nonempty source heads have prepared input references before the fresh-reader wave
No MCP advisory is allowed to deny the actual tool as completed
Source data and original observations survive service retirement
failureRule: Stop the series on a protocol, original, preparation, delivery, deadline or resource failure. Diagnose the first failed stage; no unchanged repetition or guard relaxation.
doesNotEstablish: practical 98 percent coverage across real investigations
